title: 用 PMA 读懂 Codex 的 System 与 Tools

source.translation_interface: real PMA request-scoped translation generation and cache

audiences: 第一次阅读英文 Agent 上下文的 PMA 用户
需要核对 System 与 Tools schema 的 Harness 开发者
计划制作多语言文档但不希望翻译覆盖事实源的维护者
teaching_contract.question: 怎样快速读懂长 System 和 Tools，同时保留每块译文的对应原文与完整 Raw？
teaching_contract.takeaway: 先选择目标语言，在 System / Tools 中按块切换译文，必要时展开对应原文，精确字段最终回到完整请求；翻译缓存不修改 Capture。
explicit_limits: The deterministic translation fixture proves Viewer and cache behavior, not remote translation quality.
A cache hit means one extracted material has a translation entry; it does not prove the whole request was translated.
Tool names, parameter names, JSON keys, file paths, and schema structure remain source identifiers.
Translated prose is an auxiliary reading layer; source text and Raw remain the evidence of record.
The fixture covers public English materials only and must not be used to claim universal language quality.
The Source is a public Codex-shaped teaching request over OpenAI Responses; it is not claimed to come from the real Codex CLI.

viewer.capture_mode: reproducible bundled Chromium CDP capture script

facts: Request 1 asks which two files a new Codex contributor should read, sends three system messages and two tool definitions, then receives a list_directory function_call.
Request 2 sends the matching function_call_output containing AGENTS.md and README.md, then receives the final Assistant response.
The System view reports 3/3 cached and renders three separate translated cards.
The second translated System card can expand its exact English source in place.
The Tools view reports 7/7 cached and groups translated descriptions under list_directory and read_file.
Tool and parameter identifiers remain list_directory, read_file, path, max_depth, start_line, and end_line in both modes.
The complete request still contains the original English descriptions and [REDACTED:header] authorization evidence.

production.picture_master_status: the technical master at ddb8dd06502da613a771eb4a11cdebb58d4cea37 is historical reference only; the shared launch-style title-card template requires re-export after owner story review
production.repository_policy: The seven public Viewer frames and both review directories are tracked so a clean clone can play and audit the storyboard; the MP4, render manifest, extracted video frames, fake-upstream logs, and audio remain ignored.
production.audio: handled by the separate dedicated voiceover task after Chinese narration freeze

privacy.paths: only the fixed disposable /tmp/pma-translation-codex-demo/public-project path is visible
privacy.request_body: public deterministic Codex-shaped English instructions, Chinese user request, and synthetic tool definitions only
privacy.translation_cache: contains only the ten public fixture translations
privacy.headers: placeholder authorization value is redacted before persistence

product_feedback: The Tools translation toolbar did not show the declared-versus-invoked filter for this OpenAI Responses Capture even though Request 1 contains a visible list_directory call. The chapter must not claim that filter until the product behavior is separately verified or fixed.

visual_review.raw_frame_result: passed: seven public frames were regenerated from the Codex-shaped Source with an exact 1920x1080 viewport
visual_review.annotation_result: passed internal visual review at 1920x1080 and 1024x576; waiting for owner review in the editable HTML
review_notes: The first user-message detail button does not identify a Request; the chapter uses the following Assistant detail button to open Request 1 evidence.
No arrows were added because each translated card keeps its source directly below it and the right-pane tabs already establish the click destination.
The first target-language annotation initially framed the search box; it was moved to the actual translation selector and both sizes were rerendered.
The bilingual source frame initially included the following System card; it was tightened to the expanded Safety rules block and both sizes were rerendered.
Numbered evidence appears in narrated order. Earlier numbers either exit for an independent focus or remain dimmed only when the later point must be compared with them.
The target-language selector and small Request detail entry both use click ripples in addition to rounded frames and numbered badges.
Every named review point was inspected in both contact sheets; key frames were also opened at original 1920x1080 size.
Badge centers, focus bounds, bottom-centered subtitles, and full three-pane geometry were visually inspected at both output sizes.

remaining: Review the editable HTML story and annotation geometry with the product owner.
Freeze the Chinese narration and hand semantic segments to the separate voice task.
Export a new picture master only after owner approval; the historical MP4 remains non-publishable.
Do not publish local MP4 or audio files from the main repository.
